title: Amazon.nl: digital product activated and no longer returnable
facts_text: I bought a software license key from Amazon.nl 3 days ago. I downloaded and activated it, but I no longer need it and I am asking for a refund. The digital product has already been activated, making it non-returnable in practice under the digital-product restriction.
request: Please refund EUR 49.99 for the software license, even though I have already downloaded and activated it.

strict.reason: Digital products that have been downloaded or activated are excluded from cancellation and refund once consumed or usable by the customer.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The digital product was activated, and once a digital code is activated the item is no longer eligible for a return or refund under the digital exclusion.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The category exclusion is clear; discretion may apply only to the precise threshold between downloaded and activated products.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This tests the treatment of digital products and the practical non-returnability of activated licenses.
